api_version: CatRaRE W3 Eta v2026.01, DOI 10.5676/DWD/CatRaRE_W3_Eta_v2026.01, observation window 2001-01-01–2025-12-31

request_contract.parameter_rules: ONE fixed original DWD HTTPS Range GET exactly https://opendata.dwd.de/climate_environment/CDC/event_catalogues/germany/precipitation/CatRaRE_v2026.01/data/CatRaRE_2001_2025_W3_Eta_v2026_01.csv Range: bytes=0-4095, no query/fragment, caller paths, version substitution, credentials, redirects, retries, pagination, other file downloads, CSV bulk or geometry acquisition. Expect HTTP 206 Content-Range bytes 0-4095/12410601, precisely 4096 original UTF-8 CSV bytes, semicolon-separated, 67 unique headers (CatVersion/KEY_FIELD/Event_ID first), three source-specific first event IDs. Review was scoped to ONE fixed variant and the original 2026.01 release. The W3 and T5 catalogues share the same RADKLIM-RW V2017.002 parent and cannot be treated as independent event frequencies.

response_contract.format: First 4096 original bytes of immutable W3 Eta v2026.01 semicolon-delimited 67-column event CSV, not a whole file or source geometry.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: DWD CatRaRE W3 Eta uses extreme-rain radar-derived objects from 1 km RADKLIM-RW V2017.002, 11 accumulation durations and provider event-detection / Eta selection; catalogue events are not independent of RADKLIM or of the other W3/T5 threshold catalogue. The CSV does not include an observed damage footprint, insurance exposure, loss amount or spatial EventZones geometry. Preserve UTC, event duration, event IDs qualified by threshold and version; no model admission without whole-file hash, full event uniqueness/time/geometry and independent reference validation.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Original DWD CDC-OpenData Terms_of_use.pdf documents CC BY 4.0 for CDC data. One exact 4KiB anonymously retrieved partial response is a deliberately tiny request to public source under the same dataset download terms; no claim of unlimited API service volume, no full 12/17MB CSV, no WFS, and no bulk crawler. The workflow only runs approved fixed probes from trusted main push or manual dispatch; never PR live.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Original 2026.01 DWD directory listed source CSV at exactly 12410601 bytes. Previous actual original 4KiB HTTP Range observation SHA-256 a3e02cb676b855390c0a9b69f41352c7c3dff74c7c25e2578727e8397f9d9b12 must match fresh direct run or source drift fails closed. W3 official DOI landing-page CSV link historically pointed to older missing archive; prefer only explicitly frozen current /data/2026.01 asset; preserve release and byte range. A changed original archive must be separately reviewed before re-pinning.
